payload.artist_html: Gregory F. Funston, Philip J. Currie, Chinzorig Tsogtbaatar & Tsogtbaatar Khishigjav
payload.credit_html: (2021). "A partial oviraptorosaur skeleton suggests low caenagnathid diversity in the Late Cretaceous Nemegt Formation of Mongolia". PLOS ONE 16 (7): e0254564. DOI:10.1371/journal.pone.0254564.
payload.description_html: Skeletal reconstruction of Elmisaurus rarus. Skeletal reconstruction of known elements of Elmisaurus rarus, including material referred to “Nomingia gobiensis”. Elements highlighted in red are preserved in MPC-D 102/113.
